concerns.text: FR-007 (exclusion logging) and FR-012 (motion scrubbing) lack a dedicated task to generate `data/raw/exclusions.log`. T005 mentions logging exclusions but is marked [FAILED: unspecified] and primarily focuses on data loading. Without a concrete, passing task to write this log, the downstream US1-US3 pipeline cannot filter subjects as required by the spec.

FR-007 requires logging exclusions to `exclusions.log`. T005 description says 'log exclusions' but the task is marked as failed/unspecified. There is no separate, verified task ensuring the `exclusions.log` file is created with the required headers (subject_id, reason, fd_mean) before US1 begins.

FR-001 and US1 require processing 'Subject' and 'Parcel' entities. T007 ('Create base data structures') is unchecked. Without these structures, the entropy engine (T015) and modeling tasks (T024) lack the defined data contracts to pass data between phases.

FR-001 and US1 require the final output `data/processed/subject_entropy_features.csv`. T018a (Orchestrate subject-loop) is unchecked. Without this task, the pipeline cannot aggregate individual subject entropy values into the required matrix, blocking US1 completion.

FR-008 and Plan (Complexity Tracking) require feature selection (RFE/L1) to reduce p=200 to p=20-50 to address the N=100 underpowered ratio. T023c is unchecked. Without this, the 'Connectivity-only' model will use 200 features, violating the plan's explicit requirement to prevent overfitting.

FR-004 (Permutation), FR-005 (Sensitivity), FR-006 (FDR), and SC-001/002/003/004/005/006 (Success Criteria) are unverified. Tasks T032 through T039 are all unchecked. No empirical p-values, sensitivity plots, or `model_metrics.json` can be generated without these tasks.
SC-006 requires calculating the correlation between mean entropy and mean FD. T035 is unchecked. This task is critical to verify the 'Motion Confound' edge case and the success criterion |r| < 0.3.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan (Technical Context) require a pinned environment. T003 (Configure linting/formatting) is marked [X] but the comment says 'rejected' and lacks artifacts. While not a direct FR, the lack of a clear path to environment configuration (T008 is also unchecked) threatens reproducibility.

Plan (Technical Context) explicitly requires 'CPU-only execution' and 'no CUDA flags'. T008 ('Configure environment configuration management for CPU-only execution') is unchecked. Without this, the project may fail on the GitHub Actions runner or violate the 'Neuroimaging Signal Fidelity' principle if GPU libraries are inadvertently used.

T002b is marked [X] but contains comments 'FAILED: unspecified' and 'ATOMIZE: requested'. This indicates the task description is incomplete or the implementation status is ambiguous, creating confusion about whether the virtual environment setup is actually complete.
